<div class="card-body">
'''Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker) (Dark)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ホス：防衛線　第３マーカー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">自分の兵員／トルーパーはここでは没収値－１。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここでは自分の各武器運命数にそれぞれ１を加える。ここを支配しているなら、フォース消耗に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Hoth-Defensive-Perimeter-3rd-Marker-Dark-PSA-159563447.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hoth: Defensive Perimeter, 3rd Marker.

'''Light Side:'''
Your troopers are forfeit -1 here.

'''Dark Side:'''
Add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here. If you control, Force drain +1 here.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker) (Dark)]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
